title: Hundian Social Physics Occupancy Governance & Term-Order Gate
context: PIRTM social physics models participant role allocations onto degenerate role-class sets; heuristic survey reciprocity is non-deterministic and leaks drift into the audit trail.
decision: Enforce Pauli key capacity, 5-stage gate priority, and exact multiplicity M = n_unpaired + 1 over the canonical Hundian term-order gate.
consequences: Pauli exclusion provably rejects the third occupant
